paper.title_en: Locally infrared finite two-loop amplitudes for multi Higgs production in association with one jet
paper.abstract_en: We study the two-loop amplitudes for multi-Higgs production through a massive top-quark loop in association with one jet. We consider the quark-antiquark channel with a final-state gluon, $q\bar q\to g+nH$ although our construction applies to crossed channel as well. We utilize (non-local in momentum space) Ward identities to factorize longitudinal and gauge degrees of freedom through exact identities between Feynman graphs without reference to an infrared region. In the genuine two loop topologies, we replace the internal gluons by their physical degrees of freedom and show that the resulting amplitude is free of collinear singularities. The only remaining infrared divergence is a soft singularity that can be identified with a change of reference gauge vector. We construct explicit soft counterterms for these singularities, obtaining a locally infrared-finite representation. We verify that the factorized longitudinal degrees of freedom reproduce the remaining infrared poles of the original Feynman graphs. Our formalism requires no counter-terms for collinear finiteness or for manifesting Ward identities in various regions since we perform a decomposition of covariant gauge Feynman graphs. We expect its extension to more complicated processes to eliminate all collinear singularities--particularly in the initial state.
